name: online-judge
description: Competitive programming platform: contests, leaderboards, problem management and a Docker-sandboxed asynchronous judge.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,worker,web -c blue,magenta,green "npm run dev:api -w server" "npm run dev:worker -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.setup: npm run infra:up && npm run sandbox:build && npm run db:generate && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web
